# Tony Tsang (TSANG Cheuk Nam)

> Final-year HKUST Industrial Engineering & Engineering Management student (Extended Major in AI), Hong Kong. Redesigns traditional work to be AI-native and builds the AI systems behind it, directing AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex). Winner, "Reinventing Insurance for an AI-native World" track (sponsored by bolttech), Hong Kong AI Summit: BUILD ACROSS Hackathon, October 2026. Available for internships now and full-time from January 2027. Contact: rairu0811@gmail.com.

## Case studies

- [Budget-Based Microinsurance](https://rairurairu.github.io/work/microinsurance/): an AI-native redesign of insurance where customers choose the price and AI builds the cover; a complete system in four days.
- [LLM Brand Recommendation Benchmark](https://rairurairu.github.io/work/brand-benchmark/): which brands AI assistants recommend; 50 of 51 categories validated within two days of a redesign.
- [Using LLMs for Optimization](https://rairurairu.github.io/work/llm-optimization/): IEDA Final Year Project; letting the LLM plan cut AI cost 83% at the same solution quality.
- [Polymarket Market-Making & Forecasting Models](https://rairurairu.github.io/work/polymarket-models/): AI-agent-driven quantitative research; forecasting models beat the standard Elo rating on 3,504 held-out matches.
